idle.pose: Calm combat-ready standing pose. Empty right hand rests low in front of the hip, clearly visible and ready to grip a separate weapon attachment.

charge.pose: Wide braced charging stance with the empty right hand lifted above the shoulder as if preparing an overhead strike. Keep the empty hand clearly visible.

heavy_strike.pose: Forward committed heavy-strike body pose, empty right hand extended across the torso at chest height, legs planted and readable.

recovery.pose: Low balanced recovery stance after a heavy swing. Empty right hand stays visible near the right knee; body proportions match the master exactly.
